summary:
## Target context
- Repo: DontPanic
- Env: dev
- Project: (none)
- Command: 6 (see structured target_context.commands_run)

[F003] I confirmed the gap first: `notify_event.dispatch_event` calls `event_copy.render(event)` with the event alone (`notify_event.py:259`), so `render`'s `plan_meta`/`feature_meta` parameters are never populated in production. I added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/decision_brief.py` — a frozen, equality-comparable `DecisionBrief` carrying the three elements (`what_changes`, `user_impact` + `affected_audience` + `surfaces`, `decision_consequence`), a `reversible` flag derived deterministically from the pause stage, and a `BriefStatus` of declared / possibly-stale / undeclared computed by comparing F001's `user_impact.description_hash` against a fresh SHA-256 of the feature description; nothing in it synthesizes copy. The brief is built in `supervisor._emit_gate_paused_discord` — the pause-emission site, where the `LoadedPlan` and feature record are in scope — and attached to `NotifyEvent.decision_brief` as an immutable snapshot, with `loaded` threaded through all four gate-pause call sites (single-agent, upfront, pre_impl, pre_merge). Per the step list I stopped at the snapshot; no sink reads it yet.

`pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_decision_brief_delivery.py -q` → **6 passed**, covering all five acceptance items by driving real `supervisor.dispatch_volley` pauses with the notification path unstubbed (spies wrap rather than replace `dispatch_event`/`render`), and asserting every `render` call received exactly one positional arg and no kwargs. I verified the suite
